fullPassage: Art Nouveau, literally meaning “new art,” is a style of art that emerged as a means to depart from Historicism, which relied heavily on copying or reinterpreting works from past artistic movements. In an effort to revive craftsmanship and establish a genuinely modern aesthetic that would reflect the changing times, Art Nouveau artists and designers placed emphasis on innovation, experimentation, and originality in their creations. They drew much of their inspiration from natural objects: flowers, plants, insects, and other organic forms. This focus on nature was reflected in the asymmetrical lines, curvilinear shapes, and intricate patterns that all became the hallmarks of the Art Nouveau style. Aspiring to “total works of the arts,” the practitioners of Art Nouveau used these elements to create a sense of harmony in their work. This is apparent in the works of Antoni Gaudí such as Park Güell, the design of which is perfectly integrated into the landscape, with columns seemingly sprouting from their natural surroundings.

questions.passage: Art Nouveau, literally meaning “new art,” is a style of art that emerged as a means to depart from Historicism, which relied heavily on copying or reinterpreting works from past artistic movements. In an effort to revive craftsmanship and establish a genuinely modern aesthetic that would reflect the changing times, Art Nouveau artists and designers placed emphasis on innovation, experimentation, and originality in their creations. [조건] (1) columns, from, natural, seemingly, sprouting, surroundings, their, with 를 모두 사용 (2) 8단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: '~하는 채로'를 「with+명사+현재분사」 부대상황 분사구문으로, '솟아나는'을 sprouting으로 영작해요.

det.tip: with + 명사 + 현재분사 = ~가 …한 채로 (부대상황).
